definition: ASC 340 is the U.S. accounting codification topic Other Assets and Deferred Costs, whose subtopics address accounting for specified assets or costs, including certain contract costs.
entry_text: ASC 340 is the U.S. accounting codification topic Other Assets and Deferred Costs, whose subtopics address accounting for specified assets or costs, including certain contract costs.
example: An accountant consults its contract-cost guidance to decide whether an incremental sales commission should be capitalized.
label: ASC 340
